backend/main.mo: Defines user profiles, assessment sessions, responses, scores, and career reports with access‑controlled CRUD operations and session/response management.
feature_evidence.json: Lists implemented features with associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides brief descriptions of several frontend pages and their purposes for build reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme variables, light/dark modes, and base styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up routing, authentication gating, profile initialization, and overall app layout.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Renders a login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading and error handling states.
Wraps pages with header, navigation, footer, and layout styling for the app.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal prompting new users to enter and save their initial profile information.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidates queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, managing login, identity loading, and AuthClient configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks to fetch and mutate user profiles, assessment sessions, responses, and career reports via the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining color variables for light and dark themes and applying base styles.
frontend/src/lib/assessment/questions.ts: Exports a Question interface and a large list of predefined assessment questions with options and correct answers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AssessmentCompletePag: Completes an assessment session, shows completion UI, and allows viewing results or generating a career report.
Displays a review interface for an assessment session, showing answered progress, categorizing questions, and allowing navigation to individual questions or submission.
Runs the interactive assessment flow, loading questions, saving responses, tracking progress, and providing navigation between questions and review.
frontend/src/pages/AssessmentsListPage.t: Lists user assessment sessions, showing progress for ongoing assessments and offering options to continue or start a new one.
frontend/src/pages/AssessmentStartPage.t: Presents assessment overview and tips, starts a new session, and navigates the user to the assessment runner.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Shows user profile overview, assessment stats, and quick links to start assessments or view reports.
frontend/src/pages/HistoryPage.tsx: Displays the user's past assessment sessions and generated career reports with loading states and navigation links.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Shows and edits the user's profile information with form handling and save functionality.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEditorPage.tsx: Loads a career report, allows editing its JSON content, and saves updates with version and timestamp display.
frontend/src/pages/ResultsPage.tsx: Shows assessment results, calculates category and overall scores, and allows generating a career report.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, storing, and persisting URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme, colors, animations, plugins, and content paths for the project.
project_state.json: Defines the current project version, high-level program goal, and a list of implemented features with IDs, titles, requirement links, and versions. Serves as a structured record of completed functionality for the BELKRISHNA GlobalEdge system.
